evals.name: stork-py310-incremental
evals.prompt: I'm in the clientstatus component directory. Please migrate this Stork-Debian component to Python 3.12. The repo files are in the working directory.
evals.expected_output: Detect Stork-Debian py310 path. Edit Makefile (PYTHON_VERSION py310->py312), tox.ini (envlist, find-links to {toxinidir}/dist, conda_env), Dockerfile-2004 and Dockerfile-2004-fips (FROM image, python3.10->python3.12). Print uv pip compile + conda-env-gen Docker commands with the working directory substituted in. Tell user to delete app-env-py310.yaml after generating new YAML.

assertions.text: Dockerfile-2004-fips also updated to py312 base image and python3.12
uv pip compile Docker command is printed in the response
conda-env-gen Docker command is printed in the response
User is told to delete app-env-py310.yaml
Old app-env-py310.yaml file is NOT manually edited or written to (only deletion mentioned)
pyproject.toml presence is checked; if missing, a 3-line one declaring [build-system] with setuptools.build_meta is created (or skill explicitly notes it already exists)

evals.name: stork-py38-major
evals.prompt: Help me upgrade the nsdyncleanup service from py38 to py312. It's a Stork debian component.
evals.expected_output: Detect Stork-Debian py38 path. Major Makefile restructure: move STORK config to top, add PYTHON_VERSION/COMPONENT_DIR/APP_ENV_YML, switch to conditional conda-build.mk include, add deb-install-package-items target, remove pythonpkg-py3.mk include. Major tox.ini restructure: envlist py312, add tox-conda, switch deps to conda_env. Update both Dockerfiles: base image, remove python3.8-dev, switch from .tar.gz to wheel, use python3.12 -m pip. Print Docker commands.

assertions.text: Makefile: pythonpkg-py3.mk reference replaced with conda-build.mk
Makefile: conditional include block (HAVE_MK_PYTHONPKG / ifeq) is present
Dockerfile-2004: python3.8-dev removed from apt install
Dockerfile-2004: package install switched from .tar.gz to -py3-none-any.whl
uv pip compile Docker command is printed
User is told to delete app-env-py38.yaml
pyproject.toml presence is checked; if missing, a 3-line one declaring [build-system] with setuptools.build_meta is created (or skill explicitly notes it already exists)
